papers.title: Exploratory Integration of EEG Spectral Features and Gaze Variability for Mild Cognitive Impairment Discrimination
papers.reason: The study centrally combines human gaze variability with frequency-domain EEG spectral features to discriminate mild cognitive impairment, but lacks an interactive task and cognitive process model.

papers.title: Identifying Informative Environments for Cognition Parameter Inference via Bayesian Experimental Design
papers.reason: The reported work evaluates Bayesian experimental design through Monte Carlo and amortized computational experiments without a human participant study population.

papers.title: Technological Advances in Detecting and Managing Cognitive Impairment in Older Adults: Trends, Challenges, and Future Directions
papers.reason: This review addresses human cognitive impairment monitoring and EEG and digital biomarkers broadly but does not itself implement an interactive task, eye tracking, frequency-domain EEG analysis, or cognitive process model.
